sourceAnchors.expected: Algorithm1 and sections2-3: m and v track gradient and squared-gradient exponential averages, initialized at zero. Early estimates are biased toward zero. In v1 m_t=beta1*g_t+(1-beta1)*m_previous and similarly v with squared g; correction divides by 1-(1-beta)^t, unlike later coefficient naming. Update subtracts alpha*mhat/(sqrt(vhat)+epsilon). Corrected raw second moment is not centered variance. Section3 distinguishes initialization factor from residual nonstationarity zeta. Explanation need not print equations/default hyperparameters, but any printed values must match v1. Correction does not establish universal training speed or convergence. Do not blindly reproduce incorrect informal SNR algebra as a universal equality.
